description: DSOL provides the DSOL distributed simulation framework, with model, simulator and experimental-frame components. The provider is TU Delft DSOL project. Geographical and temporal coverage: Users define models under object-oriented principles; configurable discrete-event and differential-equation simulators determine temporal behaviour. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): BSD-3-Clause. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: A generic simulation framework requires domain equations, data and validation before it predicts infrastructure performance. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
